list.title: Coupons
list.subtitle: Discount codes customers type in the cart or at checkout. The shop checks the code, the dates, the minimum order and the usage limit every time, so a coupon you switch off stops working at once.
list.readOnly: You can look at coupons but not change them. Ask an administrator for the coupon edit or delete permission.
list.timeNote: Dates and times are Dhaka time (UTC+6).
list.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} coupons. Use the search to find the others.

form.newDescription: A coupon gives a percentage or a fixed amount off the goods in the cart. Delivery charges are never discounted by a coupon.
form.editDescription: Changes apply at once, also to carts that already hold this coupon.
form.codeHint: 3 to 40 letters, digits, hyphen or underscore. Capital letters are used and spaces are removed. The code cannot be changed after saving.
form.codeLocked: The code cannot be changed: customers may already have it.
form.codeTaken: A coupon with this code already exists. Choose another code.
form.descriptionHint: For your team only. Up to {max} characters.

kinds.PercentHint: Takes a share of the cart goods off, for example 10 percent. Use the maximum discount to keep big carts safe.
kinds.FixedHint: Takes the same amount in taka off every order, never more than the goods in the cart.

form.valueAmountHint: In taka, up to 2 decimals. Bengali digits are fine.
form.capHint: The most a percentage coupon may take off one order. Empty means no cap, so 20 percent of a big cart is a big discount.
form.minimumHint: The goods in the cart must reach this value before the coupon works. Empty means no minimum.
form.example: Example: on a {basket} cart this coupon takes {discount} off, so the customer pays {pay} for the goods.
form.dhakaHint: Empty means the coupon works from now. Times are Dhaka time (UTC+6).
form.endsHint: Empty means no end date. After this moment the coupon stops working.
form.limitHint: How many orders in all may use this coupon, over all customers. Empty means no limit. A use is counted when an order is placed and given back if the order is cancelled.
form.usedNote: Already used {used} times. The limit cannot be lower than this.
form.perCustomerNote: The shop cannot yet limit a coupon to one use per customer; the limit above is shared by everyone.
form.activeOn: Customers can use it while the dates, the minimum and the limit allow.
form.activeOff: Nobody can use it, also not carts that already hold it. You can switch it on later.
form.stacksOffTitle: Default: the customer gets the better of the two
form.stacksOff: If the cart already has a promotion price or a promotion discount, the shop works out both ways (promotion only, coupon only on the normal prices) and gives the customer the larger saving. The customer never gets both. This keeps a coupon from piling on top of a sale.
form.stacksOnTitle: The coupon is added on top of promotions that allow it
form.stacksOn: The coupon is taken off after the promotions, but only when every promotion in the cart is also set to combine with a coupon. If one of them is not, the shop falls back to the better-of-the-two rule.
form.stacksBoth: Two coupons never combine on one order. A coupon that loses to a better promotion stays on the cart with the reason shown to the customer, and no use is counted.

errors.codeChars: Use only letters, digits, hyphen or underscore.
errors.valueInvalid: Enter a number, for example 10 or 250.50.
errors.valueNotPositive: The discount must be more than 0.
errors.valueTooBig: The amount is too large (at most 10,000,000).
errors.percentOver100: A percentage cannot be more than 100.
errors.minInvalid: Enter an amount in taka, or leave it empty.
errors.minNegative: The minimum order cannot be negative.
errors.minTooBig: The minimum order is too large.
errors.capInvalid: Enter an amount in taka, or leave it empty.
errors.capNotPositive: The maximum discount must be more than 0, or empty for no cap.
errors.capTooBig: The maximum discount is too large.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
errors.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number, or leave it empty for no limit.
errors.limitNotPositive: The limit must be at least 1, or empty for no limit.
errors.limitBelowUsed: The limit cannot be lower than the number of times the coupon was already used.

delete.title: Delete coupon {code}?
delete.description: Coupon {code} was never used and is in no cart, so it will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

switchOff.title: Switch off coupon {code}?
switchOff.description: Coupon {code} was used {used} times, or sits in a customer's cart, so it cannot be deleted: the record stays for the orders and reports. It will be switched off instead. Nobody can use it any more, existing orders do not change, and you can switch it on again later.

alreadyOff.title: Coupon {code} is already switched off
alreadyOff.description: Coupon {code} was used {used} times, so it cannot be deleted: the record stays for the orders and reports. It is already switched off and nobody can use it.

noEditRight.title: Coupon {code} cannot be deleted
noEditRight.description: Coupon {code} was used {used} times, so it cannot be deleted: the record stays for the orders and reports. Switching it off needs the coupon edit permission, which you do not have.

remove.inCart: This coupon is in a customer's cart, so it cannot be deleted. You can switch it off instead.
remove.switchedOff: Coupon {code} is switched off and kept for history.

errors.COUPON_CODE_TAKEN: A coupon with this code already exists. Choose another code.
errors.COUPON_NOT_FOUND: This coupon no longer exists. Reload the list.
errors.COUPON_INACTIVE: This coupon was used or is in a cart, so it cannot be deleted. Switch it off instead.
